tier_should.rationale: Innovative online and field experiments in an authoritarian election context; credible design with ballot-level outcomes; clear contribution to political economy of misinformation. Modest effect sizes and external validity concerns slightly limit universal A-journal appeal.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile team, timely topic, and rigorous design make a top field or marginal A placement likely; top-five general is plausible but uncertain given external-validity limits and modest effect sizes.
